title: Sample Residence Registration Guidance (invented demo content)

sections.heading: Registration deadline
sections.text: You must complete the residence registration within 14 days of moving into the new home. A late registration may lead to an administrative reminder, so book your slot early.

sections.heading: Required documents
sections.text: For the registration you need a valid identity document and a signed confirmation letter from the property owner. Applicants moving with family members also need one identity document per person.

sections.heading: Booking an appointment
sections.text: Appointments for the registration desk are booked online through the sample citizen portal. Walk-in slots exist but are limited to urgent cases.
